The '''Tertiary Etti Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that passed between the [[Gaurick system/Legends|Gaurick]] and [[Ocsin system/Legends|Ocsin systems]] in [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Beyond this sector the route continued in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and led to [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]] and the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] prison.<ref name="TEA" />
